title: Raw mint leaf syrup & mint lemonade
creator: thrivewithcandicee

items.note: white, same volume as the mint

steps: Wash the mint, pick the leaves and chop them roughly.
Layer equal parts mint and sugar in a jar, add a generous amount of lemon juice and press gently.
Close and leave in the fridge for 48–72 hours, stirring daily, until the sugar has dissolved into a light green syrup. Add a little water if it's slow to dissolve.
Strain and keep in the fridge.
Lemonade: fill a big glass with ice, add the juice of a lemon and some syrup, and top up with sparkling water.
